start.title: A Voz do Alto
start.text:
Deus fala contigo.
"Faze para ti uma arca. Um dilúvio está chegando."

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Receive God's command to build an ark of cypress wood
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis 6:14, 22 — God told Noah to make an ark of cypress wood, and Noah did everything just as God commanded.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Refuse the command and flee the land
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says Noah obeyed God; he did not flee.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Buy an existing ship from a merchant
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says Noah built the ark himself, as God instructed.

mockery.title: Um Mundo Observador
mockery.text:
O mundo ao teu redor é corrupto e violento.
Eles te observam construir. Como respondes?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Keep building the ark by faith
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Hebrews 11:7 — By faith Noah built the ark in reverent fear, though warned of things not yet seen.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Abandon the ark to please the crowd
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Scripture says Noah kept building by faith.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Attack the mockers to silence them
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Scripture does not describe Noah attacking anyone.

building.title: Cipreste e Betume
building.text:
Tu reúnes os materiais que Deus ordenou.
Como constróis a arca?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Build it of cypress wood, coated with pitch inside and out
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis 6:14 — Make yourself an ark of cypress wood; coat it with pitch inside and out.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Build it from cut stone
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says the ark was built of cypress wood, not stone.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Weave it from reeds like a basket
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says the ark was made of cypress wood, sealed with pitch.

ark_done.title: Está Terminada
ark_done.text:
A arca está completa, exatamente como Deus ordenou.
Como ela se parece?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] 300 cubits long, 50 wide, 30 high, with three decks
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis 6:15-16 — The ark was 300 cubits long, 50 wide, 30 high, with three decks.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] A small round boat with one deck
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis gives specific dimensions; the ark was not a small round boat.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] A raft, flat and open to the sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says the ark had a roof, three decks, and a door in its side.

animals.title: As Criaturas Vêm
animals.text:
Os animais chegam à arca.
Quem tu levas a bordo?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Take pairs of every kind of animal, male and female
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis 7:8-9 — Pairs of clean and unclean animals, birds and creeping things came to Noah, male and female.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Take only sheep and goats
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says every kind of animal came, not only sheep and goats.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Take no animals — only your family
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says the animals came into the ark with Noah.

boarding.title: A Porta Fechada
boarding.text:
É hora de entrar na arca.
Quem entra e quem fecha a porta?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Enter with your wife, three sons, and their wives; the Lord shuts the door
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis 7:13, 16 — Noah, his wife, his three sons and their wives entered the ark, and the Lord shut him in.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Enter the ark alone, leaving your family behind
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says Noah's whole household entered the ark with him.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Stay outside and close the door from without
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says the Lord Himself shut Noah inside the ark.

storm.title: Quarenta Dias de Chuva
storm.text:
As janelas do céu se abrem.
O que acontece?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Rain falls on the earth for forty days and forty nights
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis 7:12 — Rain fell on the earth forty days and forty nights.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] A single storm passes in one day
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says the rain fell for forty days and nights.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Only a light drizzle falls
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis describes the fountains of the deep bursting and the windows of heaven opening.

inside.title: Sobre as Águas
inside.text:
A arca flutua sobre as profundezas.
Por quanto tempo as águas prevalecem sobre a terra?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] The waters flood the earth for a hundred and fifty days
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis 7:24 — The waters flooded the earth for a hundred and fifty days.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] The waters recede in three days
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says the waters prevailed 150 days before receding.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] You steer the ark back toward Eden
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis does not describe Noah steering the ark; God kept it afloat.

dove.title: A Pomba Retorna
dove.text:
As águas começam a recuar.
Como sabes que a terra seca está próxima?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Send out a dove; it returns with a fresh olive leaf
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis 8:11 — The dove returned to Noah in the evening with a freshly plucked olive leaf.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Send out a raven that returns with grain
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says the dove — not the raven — brought back an olive leaf.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Open the roof and look with your own eyes only
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says Noah sent out birds to test whether the waters had gone down.

dry_land.title: Terra Sob Teus Pés
dry_land.text:
O Senhor te diz para sair da arca.
O que fazes primeiro em terra seca?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Build an altar to the Lord and offer sacrifices
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis 8:20 — Noah built an altar to the Lord and offered burnt offerings on it.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Begin building a great tower right away
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says Noah's first act was to build an altar, not a tower.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Refuse to leave the ark
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says Noah came out of the ark when God told him to.

covenant.title: O Arco-Íris
covenant.text:
Um arco-íris se curva no céu.
"Nunca mais inundarei a terra. Esta é a minha aliança contigo."
